This note is to request your guidance and approval on a high-priority invoice exception. Invoice TC-012 from Eta Consulting for $120,000.00 has been outstanding for 47 days due to two critical data omissions.

The invoice is missing a required currency code. More significantly, it was submitted without a Purchase Order number, which is a control violation for an invoice of this value. These issues prevent us from processing the payment.

Given the substantial amount and the lack of a PO, this falls outside standard AP resolution protocols and requires your sign-off before we proceed. Our recommendation is to contact the vendor for a corrected invoice with a currency code and valid PO. If this is an approved non-PO expenditure, we require your authorization to proceed.

Please provide your decision within the next two business days to avoid further payment delays and manage vendor relations.
